versions.changelog:
Major update with enhanced scraping capabilities and best practices guide.

- Added support for anti-detection techniques, including user agent rotation, random delays, and viewport randomization.
- Introduced configurable proxy support and rate limiting.
- Added data validation (schema checks) and deduplication.
- Expanded to support multiple extraction methods: static HTML, dynamic DOM, API endpoints, login, and pagination.
- Included error recovery with retry logic and exponential backoff.
- Provided implementation examples and a comprehensive workflow/best practices section.
